description: Show the user's account profile and saved settings: "what's on my profile?", "what language am I set to?", "my account settings". Returns account details, profile, general preferences, and activity counts, including saved song genre, vocals, and instruments when configured. Unset preference fields may be absent; do not infer values for missing fields. Use list_audio_preference_profiles to select a named saved sound for generation. Read-only. To learn what aiponge has noticed from reflections, including themes and patterns, use get_insights instead.
name: get_profile
title: Show my profile and preferences
